title: Remove analytics dashboard and CSV import/export features
description: Analytics dashboard widgets (DealsChart, DealsPipeline, DashboardStepper deal-phase logic) and CSV import/export functionality (ContactImportButton, useContactImport, ExportVCardButton, ExportButton, BulkExportButton in contacts list, ImportPage) are disabled for this deployment. The Dashboard component becomes a simple welcome/activity-log page. The misc/ImportPage route is removed. CSV-related dependencies (jsonexport, papaparse usage in usePapaParse) are removed from the contacts list. Note: the Dashboard itself (activity log, LatestNotes, HotContacts) is retained.
acceptance_criteria: src/components/atomic-crm/dashboard/DealsChart.tsx and DealsPipeline.tsx and DashboardStepper.tsx are deleted
src/components/atomic-crm/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx renders only activity log, LatestNotes, and HotContacts — no deal-count checks or analytics widgets
src/components/atomic-crm/contacts/ContactList.tsx removes ExportButton, BulkExportButton, ContactImportButton, and CSV export exporter prop
src/components/atomic-crm/misc/ImportPage.tsx is deleted and its route removed from CRM.tsx
src/components/atomic-crm/misc/usePapaParse.tsx is deleted if only used by import/export
No import of jsonexport, downloadCSV, or papaparse remains in the contacts list file

non_functional_requirements.performance: Contact list toolbar is simplified; no large CSV libraries loaded
